cases.name: Lori Gale Billingsley
cases.about: She was a Aloha High School student.
cases.narrative:
On 10/10/1982, her body was found in a ditch on Miller Hill Rd. in Aloha, OR. She had been beaten, strangled, stabbed, and sexually assaulted.

Prosecutors told the jury that Hicks, then 19, was drunk and upset after his friend turned him down for sex. He then ran into Billingsley, his uncle's neighbor, with whom he'd been infatuated. According to witnesses, Billingsley wasn't interested in Hicks.

Hicks raped Billingsley, then struck her in the head, strangled her and stabbed her 12 times with a small lock-blade pocketknife, prosecutors said. He wrapped her body in a drop cloth and dumped her in a ditch along Southwest Miller Hill Road.
